title: On generalized Namioka spaces and joint continuity of functions on product of spaces
summary: A space $X$ is called a generalized Namioka space (g$\mathcal{N}$-space), if for every compact space $Y$ and every separately continuous function $f\colon X\times Y\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$, there exists at least one point $x\in X$ such that $f$ is jointly continuous at each point of $\{x\}\times Y$. We principally prove the following results: (1) If $X=\prod_{α\in A}X_α$ is non-meager such that each factor is a separable space or each factor is a pseudo-metric space, then $X$ is a g$\mathcal{N}$-space.
